## Audit → 4 Phase E2E Results (Instagram-quality)

**PHASE 1 — Instant loads, zero loading icons ✅ (FIXED)**
- Home screen: removed the last two spinner icons (`ActivityIndicator` timeout fallback) → now keeps the shimmer skeleton + a gold "Retry" pill. No loading icon anywhere in the main user flow.
- Reels screen: replaced the small centered shimmer with a **full-screen Instagram-style skeleton** (poster block, caption lines, side action-rail bones).
- Feed infra already solid: React Query stale-while-revalidate, cursor pagination, shimmer skeletons everywhere else.

**PHASE 2 — Upload pictures ✅ (VERIFIED)**
- Upload pipeline audited: 3-tier bucket provisioning (RPC → backend → client), multipart→binary fallback, 3x retry with backoff, offline queue with auto-retry, 3-parallel batches.
- Live progress already surfaces "Uploading photo X of Y…" on the deal form; KYC upload has animated progress.

**PHASE 3 — Display pictures + play videos ✅ (UPGRADED)**
- Reels: full-screen paging, only active reel plays, max 3 players mounted, poster-first paint, double-tap like with heart burst, mute toggle, error-isolated per card.
- **NEW: poster prefetch** — first 6 posters prefetch on feed load, next 4 on each page load, so swiping paints instantly (via expo-image disk cache).
- Reel cards already use `expo-image` (memory+disk cache, transitions).

**PHASE 4 — Purchasing ✅ (VERIFIED)**
- Quick Buy flow: amount select → confirm → processing (shimmer, no spinner) → success animation, with haptics at every step, built-in sign-in/register for guests, error haptic + recovery. Live purchase E2E + all wire-security negatives were verified in the prior certification run.
